sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Block Puzzle Merge are simple yet addictive. Players are presented with a 8x8 board, where they must drag and drop colored tiles to match rows or columns. The game ends when there's no more space on the board to place cubes, and the player's score is calculated based on the number of tiles cleared. One of the unique features of Block Puzzle Merge is its square tiles, which cannot be rotated. This adds an extra layer of challenge and uncertainty to the game, as players must carefully plan their moves to achieve the highest score. As players progress through the game, new shapes and tiles are introduced, increasing the difficulty level and requiring players to adapt their strategies.

The game's physics engine is smooth and responsive, making it easy to maneuver the tiles and plan your moves. One of the key features of Block Puzzle Merge is its combo system, which rewards players for clearing multiple rows or columns at once. The more combos you achieve, the higher your score. With its simple yet addictive gameplay, Block Puzzle Merge is a game that is perfect for players of all ages and skill levels.
